name: warm-capabilities
description: Figments host flow: 31 resident host tools guarded by RunSpec.capabilities, warm catalogue, quiet warm turn, then a fresh text document attachment and the host's document-tool publication. Each turn checks one authorized host operation; quiet callback entries must be zero, fresh document entries must be positive. SQL statements, rows and WAL bytes are counted independently.

turns.user: Warm the host catalogue with the document capability.
Use the existing host tool under the same document capability; the catalogue is unchanged.
Attach a fresh document and read it through its newly published host operation.
